name: JWT Decoder
description: Decode JWT headers and payloads, check expiry, verify signatures and sign new tokens
help: Decoding needs no key; the three token parts are highlighted in different colors and a Bearer prefix is accepted.
Enter the secret (HS) or a PEM public key (RS / PS / ES / EdDSA) to verify the signature live; expiry is reported separately from the signature.
Signing supports HS, RS, PS, ES and EdDSA and can add header fields such as kid.
Tokens with alg none are never treated as verifiable; tokens and keys stay local and are never written to history.
